newsitem.title: USA: Rentrak sees Q3 earns below prior year.
newsitem.headline: Rentrak sees Q3 earns below prior year.

text.p: Rentrak Corp Friday said that fiscal third quarter earnings will be "down significantly" from the $1.5 million record a year ago.
Rentrak also said it saw revenues between $22 and $25 million, off from $32 million last year.
The rental video distributor said that movie titles in the current quarter are substantially weaker than the unusually strong selection available during the 1995 third quarter.
Company president Ron Berger, in a statement, expressed optimism and said the fourth quarter will show "positive results."
